mapper.sql: id, category_id, seller_id, name, subtitle, main_image, sub_images, detail, price, stock, status, sales, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product WHERE category_id = #{categoryId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product (category_id, seller_id, name, subtitle, main_image, sub_images, detail, price, stock, status, sales) VALUES (#{categoryId}, #{sellerId}, #{name}, #{subtitle}, #{mainImage}, #{subImages}, #{detail}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{status}, #{sales})
